Name: Nyapu Style Mount Vapius by AhCuteArt
Author: AhCuteArt
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Goodness, it’s finally finished. It took me a while to draw up the portraits because of all the edits I had to do. I drew several characters based on my artistic interpretation because I had trouble finding references or wasn't sure how they were supposed to look. Overall, I thought they turned out well.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
NOTE: I couldn’t find most of the expression changes, so if any of the characters' emotions don’t match their dialogue, let me know so I can correct them.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][Main File] CP is just a drag-and-drop into your mods folder, and you're ready to go.[/color]

[Optional File] The portrait replacement overwrites the portraits. The manual replacement doesn't include my sprite edits. So some of the portraits and sprites might not match. 

[size=4][b]Extra Features (Only for Content Patcher Version)[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]The CP mod includes portraits not programmed in by the main mod, plus sprite corrections so the portraits match the characters. [/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]For details on all the changes I made, please see the LOG tab. [/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]You'll need [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600]Lumisteria Visit Mount Vapius[/url][/color] for this mod to work. 

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][i]BIG thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/54606682]nyapu[/url] for letting me use their art as a base. 
The BIGGEST thank you to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/1249127]DolphinIsNotaFish[/url] for always helping me debug and help write some of the code. [/i]
[i]Thank you  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/5575844]Lumisteria[/url]  for allowing me to retexture your mod[/i]
[i]Thank you earthtosyd for giving me your living portrait frame edit.  [/i]

[i]Just wanted to mention [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4911240]mishoonty[/url] and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31483]Nyapu style Visit Mount Vapius[/url]. [/i] [/color]
